title: Sacrifice

vars.note: Dynamically calculated as 2× Osty's Max HP if alive

description: If [gold]Osty[/gold] is alive, he dies and you gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to double his Max HP.
notes: Retain keyword ensures this card is not discarded after playing. Block gain is conditional on Osty being alive at play time. Calculated as 2× Osty's Max HP.
